purpose: Authoritative corpus-scoping overlay. The register's legacyPaths/legacyFiles/legacyLines are GENERATED by tools/parity-matrix.cjs from inline row definitions; regenerating them would rewrite history. This overlay records the capability-scoped correction separately, and tools/m8b-integrity-verify.py consults it as the effective corpus.

rules.clientOnly: a FULL row with no endpoints may pass C06 only if a clientOnly rationale is recorded here
